name: pain
title: Pain & Impact
description: What is hurting the buyer today, in their own words, and the consequence they attach to it.
prompt:
List every pain point the buyer expresses about their current situation, one entry per distinct pain.

For each pain point:
- evidence: cite the utterance(s) where the buyer expresses it, before you write "text".
- text: the pain in the buyer's exact words wherever a direct quote exists — never rewritten into corporate register, never softened, no converting number words to digits or digits to number words.
- impact: the consequence the buyer attaches to it, quoted verbatim when spoken ("we lose deals every week"). Use an empty string when the buyer states no consequence — never infer one.

A pain point is something hurting them TODAY. A hypothetical ("it would be bad if…"), a negated statement ("we do NOT have that problem"), or a reported third-party view ("our old vendor said…") is not the buyer's pain. Only extract what is actually in the transcript. An empty list is a valid, correct result.
